svg.text: ldo_capless -- capless LDO, 3.3 V in -> 1.0-1.8 V trimmed out
Signal path: vref_bg (1.2 V harness bandgap) -> ldo_vref halves it to 0.6 V -> ldo_erramp
compares against vfb -> eout drives the ldo_pass PMOS array -> vout -> ldo_fbtrim divides
back to vfb with 5-bit trim. Cc is the Miller compensation around the pass device; Cout is
the on-chip stabilising capacitor that replaces the external one this topology does without.
